title: SDRF, fire personnel go missing after rescue boats capsize in Khammam tank
description: Ten SDRF and fire services personnel reportedly went missing after two rescue boats capsized during an operation at Bethupalli tank in Sathupalli, Khammam district, on Wednesday. The rescue team had reached the spot to save fishermen stranded in floodwaters following a sudden rise in the tank's water level due to cyclonic rains.

title: Fake Rythu Bharosa credit messages trigger confusion among Telangana farmers; cyber complaint lodged
description: Unauthorised SMS messages claiming that Rythu Bharosa funds had been credited to farmers' bank accounts sparked confusion across Telangana, with thousands of recipients finding no deposits in their accounts. The Agriculture Department has lodged a complaint with Cyber Crime police, seeking an investigation into the origin of the messages and possible misuse of SMS communication systems.

title: 45-53 pc street vendors may scale back UPI use if MDR imposed: ISB study
description: A study by the Centre for Analytical Finance at the Indian School of Business has found that a significant proportion of street vendors may reduce their use of UPI payments if Merchant Discount Rate (MDR) charges are imposed. The survey highlights concerns over the impact of transaction fees on digital payment adoption.

title: Floodwaters from Peddavagu project inundate farmlands in Andhra’s Velairpad

The project, already breached in July 2024 and further damaged in September the same year.

title: SCR arranges special train for stranded passengers amid Cyclone Murasu disruptions

Besides operating a special train to Vijayawada, the railway provided food, refreshments, additional stoppages and round-the-clock operational monitoring to ensure passenger safety and convenience.

description: AP News | మురసు తుపాను ప్రభావంతో గోదావరి జిల్లాల్లో భారీ వర్షాలు కురుస్తున్నాయి. అత్యధికంగా ఏలూరు జిల్లా బయ్యనగూడెంలో 18.2 సెంటీమీట‌ర్లు, జీలుగుమిల్లిలో 13.9 సెంటీమీట‌ర్‌లు, పి నారాయణపురంలో 12.8 సెంటీమీట‌ర్లు, కాకినాడ జిల్లా ఆర్యవటంలో 12.6 సెంటీమీట‌ర్లు, పెదపూడిలో 12.6 సెంటీమీట‌ర్లు, కాజులూరులో 12.1 సెంటీమీట‌ర్లు, కరపలో 12 సెంటీమీట‌ర్లు, వేళంగిలో 11.4 సెంటీమీట‌ర్లు, జి మామిడిలో 11.2 సెంటీమీటర్ల వర్షపాతం నమోదైంది.

description: చెవిలో ఏర్పడే గులిమిని వైద్య పరిభాషలో సెరుమెన్‌ అంటారు. ఈ పదం గ్రీకు భాషలోని కెరోస్‌ అనే పదం నుంచి వచ్చింది. దాని అర్థం తేనెటీగల మైనం. పురాతన కాలం నుంచే చెవిలో గులిమి గురించి మనుషులు ఆసక్తి చూపుతున్నారు. ప్రపంచంలోని వివిధ పురావస్తు ప్రదేశాల్లో గులిమిని తొలగించేందుకు ఉపయోగించే చిన్న పరికరాలు, చెంచాల వంటి వస్తువులు బయటపడ్డాయి.

title: AI data center stocks dip, renewables surge after Democrat sweep in US midterm elections
description: AI data centre stocks declined while renewable energy and healthcare shares rallied after Democrats won control of Congress in the US midterm elections. Investors assessed the possibility of tighter AI oversight and continued clean energy support. Defence contractors and prison operators fell amid concerns over changing government spending and immigration policies.

title: US Treasury shifts language, opening door to auction size changes
description: The US Treasury Department has updated its regulations regarding upcoming auction sizes for treasury securities. This revision hints at a potential increase in the issuance of short- and intermediate-term debt. They also flagged a likely decrease in demand for longer-term 20- and 30-year auctions. Future adjustments will rely on demand trends and financial requirements, with the Treasury planning to consult market participants for a thorough understanding of these changing factors.

title: Meta draws record orders for debut euro bond sale, Bloomberg News reports
description: Meta Platforms has successfully garnered an impressive €53 billion in investor interest for its inaugural euro bond issuance. With an ambition to raise €9 billion divided into six distinct parts, this move follows their recent $15 billion bond offering in the US market. Citigroup and Morgan Stanley are at the helm of this euro bond sale, with pricing anticipated shortly. As of September 30, Meta's total debt reached $83.67 billion.

title: Gold gains 3% as dollar slides after Democratic midterm gains
description: On Wednesday, gold prices surged by 3%, reaching impressive new levels following the midterm elections, during which Democrats secured control of both the Senate and House. This political transformation, combined with a weaker dollar, heightened gold and precious metals demand. Investors are keenly watching for the upcoming US non-farm payrolls report, as rising interest rates and ongoing fiscal risk concerns continue to influence market sentiment.

title: Prediction markets get Democratic win right, with a few surprises
description: Prediction markets provided insights during the US midterm elections, with $1.48 billion wagered on the outcomes. Democrats gained control of both the Senate and House of Representatives after delivering a rebuke to Donald Trump. Despite some accurate forecasts, notable surprises emerged, such as Annie Andrews' victory in South Carolina against expectations. Kalshi and Polymarket reflected varying probabilities, emphasizing the predictive capabilities of betting markets.

title: Indian bonds rally most since April as oil slides after US midterm verdict
description: Indian government bonds experienced a significant rally influenced by falling oil prices after the US midterm elections. The benchmark bond yield dropped notably, reflecting a three-day decline in yields. Brent crude oil prices decreased, easing inflation and fiscal pressures on India. The Reserve Bank of India anticipates inflation will peak this quarter, supporting future bond market performance.

title: Aptus Value Housing Finance Q2 profit rises 18% to Rs 267 cr
description: Aptus Value Housing Finance India achieved a remarkable net profit of Rs 267 crore in the second quarter, signifying strong financial growth. The total income surged to Rs 634 crore, up from Rs 554 crore the year prior. Additionally, interest income climbed to Rs 551 crore from Rs 472 crore.

title: Keystone Realtors Q2 profit jumps 10-fold to Rs 101 cr
description: Keystone Realtors has announced a ten-fold increase in consolidated net profit for the quarter ended September. The net profit rose to Rs 100.75 crore, attributed to significant profit share from joint ventures. Total income for the quarter, however, saw a decline from the previous year. The company's pre-sales reached record levels, reflecting strong demand for luxury housing projects.

title: Property giant Vonovia 'concerned' over Berlin left's housing plans
description: Europe's leading corporate landlord Vonovia said Wednesday it was "concerned" at plans by Berlin's possible incoming far-left led city administration to expropriate apartments to tackle the city's housing crisis. "Of course, we are concerned about plans to nationalise housing owned by private companies," Vonovia CEO Luka Mucic told reporters Wednesday during a conference call on the company's third-quarter results.

title: Sunday PropTech acquires 89-room hotel in Kolkata, marks entry into city
description: Sunday PropTech Ltd marks a significant milestone with its inaugural acquisition of an 89-room hotel in Rajarhat. This venue will be included in its emerging mid-premium Clubhouse brand, bolstering its footprint in eastern India. Given its advantageous proximity to Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose International Airport, it appeals to business travelers. The company plans to revamp and reposition the hotel, while also identifying additional investment prospects in West Bengal.
